description: Recover the exact hidden file from an Omniseal sealed file using its private seed. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

private_seed.description: User-supplied Omniseal private seed. Never use an account password or API credential.

sealed_file.description: An explicitly supplied file. Provide exactly one HTTPS download URL or exact base64 bytes. Claude attachment IDs and local paths are not downloadable URLs.

name: retrieve_secret_file
title: Retrieve secret file
